releases.notes:
## ChestMaster 1.3.1

**Supported: Minecraft 26.1–26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3 (Fabric).**

### Added
- **Minecraft 26.3** support
- **Shard prices** by attribute (Bazaar), including renamed shards
- **Level-aware pet prices** (type, rarity and level range, plus held item and skin)
- Automatic fallback source for auction prices
- Full value breakdown with item icons (no more "+N more")
- Config option to exclude applied dyes and skins from item values

### Fixed
- Chests outside your Private Island (e.g. dungeon secret chests) are no longer indexed; old stray entries are cleaned up once
- Chest markers are drawn only on your Private Island
- Emptied chests now clear their entries
- Search results are no longer capped at 2000 rows
- Unique items (same UUID) are listed once
- The GUI no longer jumps to the top when prices update
- Champion, Toxophilite, Compact and other use-leveled enchantments are now valued
- Enchanted books are no longer listed as "No price"
- Item names keep their original colours (pet level, stars)

releases.notes:
**Supported: Minecraft 26.1–26.1.2 and 26.2 (Fabric).**

> ChestMaster now runs on **SkyBlockAPI** — the library used by many SkyBlock mods. It is **bundled**, nothing extra to install (the JAR grew to ~8.5 MB because of it).

## 🔄 Reworked chest tracking
- The chest position comes from **right-clicking the chest** — exact coordinates, no guessing
- Only **real chests** are indexed — Hypixel menus like Loadouts, auction dialogs or Sack of Sacks can never get in, **in any client language**
- Contents are saved **when you close the chest**, so everything is always loaded
- Each half of a double chest remembers its own items
- **Breaking a chest removes it** from the index; items you take out disappear too
- Tracking works **only on your Private Island**

## 💰 Much better and faster item valuation
- All prices now come from SkyBlockAPI: Bazaar, lowest-BIN, NPC prices and a full item value calculator
- Enchantments at any level are valued correctly — **Chimera V is no longer worth 0!** Also stars & master stars, gemstones, reforges, drill & rod parts, Necron scrolls, runes, dyes, skins and pets
- The detail panel shows where the value comes from
- No more endless "Loading..." — prices show up as soon as the market data is there

## ✨ New highlighting
- **Chest markers** are now a translucent **rainbow box visible through walls**; double chests light up as a whole
- **In-inventory highlight** — select an item in the GUI and every matching stack lights up in any open inventory
- **Auto-clear** — highlights clear themselves after a configurable time (Mod Menu → *Clear highlights after*, default 1 min)

## ⌨️ Search the hovered item
Hover any item in an inventory and press the *Open ChestMaster* key (set it in Controls) to search for it instantly.

---

### Русский
- **Новый трекинг сундуков**: позиция берётся из клика по сундуку, в базу попадают только настоящие сундуки (меню Hypixel — никогда, на любом языке), сохранение при закрытии, у двойного сундука каждая половина хранит свои предметы, сломанный сундук удаляется из базы, работает только на своём Private Island.
- **Быстрая и точная оценка**: все цены теперь берутся из SkyBlockAPI — зачарования любого уровня (Химера V больше не 0), звёзды, гемы, реформы, части дрелей/удочек, свитки Necron, руны, красители, скины, петы. Больше никакого бесконечного «Loading...».
- **Новая подсветка**: сундук в мире — полупрозрачный радужный блок, видимый сквозь стены; найденные предметы подсвечиваются прямо в инвентарях; подсветка сама сбрасывается по таймеру.
- **Поиск по наведению**: навёл на предмет, нажал клавишу ChestMaster — открылся поиск этого предмета.
- Библиотека **SkyBlockAPI встроена** — отдельно ставить ничего не нужно.

| Minecraft | JAR |
|---|---|
| 26.1 / 26.1.1 / 26.1.2 | `chestmaster-mc26.1.2-1.3.0+mc26.1.2.jar` |
| 26.2 | `chestmaster-mc26.2-1.3.0+mc26.2.jar` |

releases.notes:
**Supported / Поддерживается: Minecraft 26.1–26.1.2 and 26.2 (Fabric, Java 25).**

Bug-fix release on top of 1.2.0.

## Fixed / Исправлено
- **Hypixel menus no longer land in the database / Меню Hypixel больше не попадают в базу.**
  The scanner now indexes **only** containers whose title exactly matches a vanilla storage
  name (Chest / Large Chest / Barrel / Shulker Box, in your client language). Every server
  menu — Loadouts, the "At what price are you selling?" auction dialog, Sack of Sacks,
  Storage, backpacks — is a custom-titled fake chest and is now reliably skipped, even when
  opened while facing a real chest.

  Сканер теперь индексирует только контейнеры с ванильным именем сундука; все серверные меню
  Hypixel надёжно игнорируются, даже если открыты лицом к сундуку.
- Startup DB cleanup extended to these menu titles — junk rows from earlier versions are
  removed automatically / старые мусорные записи удаляются автоматически при запуске.

> Note: chests renamed with a name tag are also skipped now (their title isn't a vanilla
> name) — this is the only reliable way to keep menus out.

| Minecraft | JAR |
|---|---|
| 26.1 / 26.1.1 / 26.1.2 | `chestmaster-mc26.1.2-1.2.1+mc26.1.2.jar` |
| 26.2 | `chestmaster-mc26.2-1.2.1+mc26.2.jar` |

Older 1.21.x builds are no longer maintained / сборки для 1.21.x больше не поддерживаются.

| Minecraft | JAR |
|---|---|
| 26.1 / 26.1.1 / 26.1.2 | `chestmaster-mc26.1.2-1.2.0+mc26.1.2.jar` |
| 26.2 | `chestmaster-mc26.2-1.2.0+mc26.2.jar` |

## Added / Добавлено
- **MC 26.2 support** — port to the new extract/submit rendering pipeline
- **Mod Menu config screen**: auto-scan, verbose logging, default sort, price mode, price refresh interval
- **Pet valuation** by type + tier (Coflnet fallback with rate-limit handling)
- **Attribute shard valuation** via Bazaar `SHARD_*` products
- **Open on Bazaar / AH** button in the detail panel (`/bz` / `/ahs`)
- **Live price updates** in the open GUI as market data arrives
- Mod icon, keybinding translations (EN/RU)

## Fixed / Исправлено
- Ender Chest pages, dungeon/Kuudra reward chests and Hypixel menu GUIs are no longer scanned; old junk rows are purged from the DB automatically on startup
- Crash on empty config file; config now always UTF-8
- CSV export no longer aggregates rows or caps at 2000 — full per-chest data
- Minecraft version pinned per build (a 1.21.10 JAR could load and crash on newer MC)
- Search query reset on window resize; price mode now persists between sessions
- `/cm reset` now actually shrinks the DB file

## Changed / Изменено
- **JAR size: 13.6 MB → 3.7 MB** — dropped SQLite natives for platforms Minecraft never runs on

releases.notes:
## Supported Minecraft versions
`1.21.10` · `1.21.11` · `26.1` · `26.1.2`

## 🆕 Added
- Multi-version support — separate JAR per MC version
- MC 26.1 / 26.1.2 support (first unobfuscated version, requires Java 25)
- Per-server item tracking — no cross-server data mixing
- "Last seen" timestamps for each scanned chest
- CSV export: `/cm export` / `/cm export all`
- Auto-Scan toggle button directly in the GUI
- Sort modes (price / name / count) — saved between sessions
- Source filter: All / Bazaar / Auction / Unknown
- Settings persist across game restarts
- LBIN price fallback to `sky.coflnet.com` if `moulberry.codes` is unreachable
- AH unavailability warning shown in GUI
- `/cm logs on|off|status` — verbose logging toggle

## 🐛 Fixed
- Crash on item click (MC 26.x) — renamed GUI methods
- Crash on chest highlight (MC 1.21.x / 26.x) — added `setLineWidth`
- "Incompatible mods" on MC 26.1 — fixed version range in `fabric.mod.json`
- Crash on keybind press — proper `KeyMapping.Category` registration
- Chest highlight not rendering on MC 1.21.11 — switched to `AFTER_ENTITIES`
- **Scanning broken after database reset** — `CREATE INDEX` on `serverKey` was running before `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN`; index is now created after schema migration
